slices.title: Purpose tag on every inference call; side tasks inherit floors
slices.summary: Adds enum InferPurpose (UNSPECIFIED=0 .. SCHEDULED_ROUND=16) and InferRequest.purpose=21 (round A: EP-14 takes run_id=22, EP-13 S4 role_fallback_model=23). inference-core adds a bounded purpose label to inference_requests_total and inference_tokens_total, unknown values count as unspecified. Every non-test InferRequest construction in gateway, execution-core and session-core names a purpose, enforced by a source-text inventory test. subscription_scoped_request is split so inherit_turn_floors always copies privacy-tier and residency floors; CallPhase gains purpose(). Land first in its train, one commit per crate.

decisions_defaults.D8: Side tasks always copy min_privacy_tier and min_residency (and zdr where the call carries turn content); ships ungated as a tightening, title stays skipped for ZDR turns.
decisions_defaults.D9: Purpose is a metrics label only in W3; no cost_entries.purpose column (DEC-18).

slices.title: Gemini adapter core on Vertex, registered dark
slices.summary: Adds a Vertex token provider (service-account JWT exchange, cached, single-flight, redacted Debug) and GeminiProvider with unary and streamed text over generateContent/streamGenerateContent, usage and cached-token mapping, typed safety-block errors, vision/structured output refused until later. Adds ModelFamily::Gemini, excludes Gemini ids from the OpenAI family in provider_serves_model (otherwise they 404 on Azure OpenAI), and registers only when VERTEX_GEMINI_ENABLED plus project, EU location, credentials file and model list are present. supports_zdr is a constant false. No proto or migration; compose wiring waits for S8.

decisions_defaults.D1: Register Gemini as EU-resident, non-ZDR provider for non-ZDR turns with floor at most EU_RESIDENT; build dark, enablement waits on owner ruling (S8).
decisions_defaults.D4: Native Vertex generateContent / streamGenerateContent adapter, not the OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
decisions_defaults.D5: No thought-signature replay in W3; adapter ignores returned signatures.
decisions_defaults.D12: Residency derived from VERTEX_GEMINI_LOCATION against an EU allowlist; anything else classifies Global.
decisions_defaults.D13: Service-account credentials are an inference-core secret file (VERTEX_GEMINI_CREDENTIALS_FILE), token minted hourly, never logged.

slices.title: Run ledger view v1
slices.summary: Adds an optional turnId to VerevonUiEvent (appendUiEvent stores the id it already receives) and a pure buildLedger that groups events by turn, round and tool-call pair, with an unattributed group so nothing is dropped and the 5,000 cap notice kept. RunLedger and LedgerInspector replace the flat list in TracePanel behind VITE_CHAT_RUN_LEDGER, with copy request id and run id and an Inspect action on tool cards. No server, proto or migration; durations use recorded timestamps only.
slices.remaining: Whole slice: turnId on UI events, buildLedger, RunLedger and inspector drawer, TracePanel switch, Inspect action.

slices.title: Replay fake and synthetic cassettes in CI
slices.summary: New dev-only crate mp-inference-replay with ReplayInference implementing the InferenceCore trait from mp-replay-v1 cassettes (tokenised volatile ids, loader refuses synthetic != true or zdr == true), six hand-written synthetic cassettes, and replay_sessions integration tests in model-gateway and execution-core that assert SSE event names and final state. A test asserts no service lists the crate as a runtime dependency. CI picks up the new test targets. No proto or migration. The matching step may reuse S6's canonicaliser when present, else its own.
slices.remaining: Whole slice: replay crate, six synthetic cassettes, gateway and execution-core replay suites, CI wiring.

cd "apps/Model Plane/rust" && cargo test -q -p execution-core --test replay_sessions

decisions_defaults.D8: Cassette format mp-replay-v1 JSONL, synthetic only; replay suite required in CI at 100% pass, credential-free; matching is structural (call index, purpose, tools offered, last role), not by text.
